'Deciding when fine-tuning is worthwhile' is unshipped by ~45 actors, plausibly because the answer is usually 'don't'. Provider terms (OpenAI API, Anthropic 2026-03-16 guidance, Google 2026-04-28) restrict training on outputs; routers trained on outcome metadata fit the classifier exceptions. Local training remains deferred under ADR-0010.
